prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters, simple rounded people with big round eyes, small dot pupils and overbites, flat colour and black outlines everywhere except the faces, which are rendered with startling real skin: pores, stubble, sweat, tired wet eyes. Every flat colour is laid on with thick visible oil brushstrokes. Only the bodies, clothes and places are cartoon: every face in the frame, however small, is painted as real human skin with wrinkles, pores, bags under the eyes and real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it. Seen from down on the wet cobbles of a narrow back alley at dawn, looking steeply up: in the back doorway of a 1930s bakery, a heavy-set Black baker in his fifties with a shaved head, a broken nose and a round double chin, in a floury sweat-stained vest, tips a thin brown paper pay packet over his open palm; three small copper coins and a dusty grey moth tumble out towards the camera. Beside him a thin white foreman in his sixties with a waxed grey moustache, a waistcoat and a pencil behind his ear is already turning away. Pale cold dawn sky above the alley with a small fading red moon; warm orange light spilling from the doorway behind them. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
